# Neuhaus Foot & Ankle

> Board-certified podiatrists and foot and ankle surgeons treating children and adults at 15 clinics across Nashville and Middle Tennessee. Phone 615-220-8788.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.neufoot.com/): Practice overview, services and locations
- [Our providers](https://www.neufoot.com/doctors/): 16 podiatrists and foot and ankle surgeons, each with a profile page
- [Services](https://www.neufoot.com/services/): Care groups for heel pain, bunions, ankle injuries, arthritis, fractures, diabetic foot care and children's foot care
- [Locations](https://www.neufoot.com/locations/): Address, map and services for each of the 15 clinics
- [Book an appointment](https://www.neufoot.com/book-appointment/): Online booking links for every clinic
- [Patient resources](https://www.neufoot.com/patient-resources/): Forms, billing and what to bring to a visit
- [Blog](https://www.neufoot.com/blog/): Foot and ankle health articles written by the practice
